payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-02 (offline repo read on main at 45a3dcacb54a; no provider access). TWO of the four recorded claims hold, ONE holds with a corrected mechanism, and the central technical premise is REFUTED by the code on main. REFUTED: 'deletes an artifact family BEFORE calling OpenAI and re-inserting, one family at a time, never staged-then-swapped'. In all four writers in supabase/functions/indexing-v3-agent/index.ts - upsertMemoryCardsFromSections:1124, upsertSectionIndexUnits:1246, upsertVisualArtifacts:1382, upsertCoreEmbeddingFields:1477 - the embeddingBatch await completes BEFORE sql.begin is entered, and the delete and re-insert share one Postgres transaction. A provider outage therefore aborts before any delete happens, and a failed insert rolls the delete back; the 'permanently empty family' failure mode does not follow from this code. tests/indexing-v3-agent.test.ts:189-211 already pins that ordering statically for all four. (This assessment is against current main; the checkout is shallow and the cited audit commits 3ed1932/1bb362f are not reachable, so whether the file has since been fixed or the claim was inaccurate from the outset is not established.) CONFIRMED: repair_strict_enrichment_gate_batch is invoked by nothing - every repo-wide hit is the migration, the schema mirror, generated types, drift bookkeeping, docs, or a schema-text assertion. CONFIRMED: no monitoring - needs_enrichment_artifacts appears in no script and no workflow. CONFIRMED WITH CORRECTED MECHANISM: both terminal states are excluded from claim eligibility forever, but by two different routes - claim_indexing_v3_agent_jobs (20260724060000:41-57) excludes needs_enrichment_artifacts by NAME in 'status not in (...)', while 'failed' is excluded through 'attempt_count < max_attempts', because agentFailureDecision only writes 'failed' once attempts are spent. NEW FINDING, the reason the recorded fix would not have worked: repair_strict_enrichment_gate_batch touches documents.metadata, document_index_quality and ingestion_jobs and NEVER touches indexing_v3_agent_jobs, so even wired to a caller it could not have unstuck a stuck document. Its 'strict_gate_repair' stage string is also unrecognised by worker/main.ts, so a queued repair job is processed as an ordinary pending ingestion job. ADDRESSED in this change: migration 20260902120000 adds the indexing_v3_agent_jobs reset, scripts/repair-strict-enrichment-gate.ts is the operator caller (dry-run first, --apply --yes, health-probed, deliberately not automated), and check:enrichment-health counts the stuck states. REMAINING: docs/ingestion-state-machine.md R24d - a cross-route race with deep-memory.ts's unscoped deletes - is a real defect on a different code path and is queued separately.
